+
+
+def _newest_meta(video_id):

     os.makedirs(_vdir(video_id), exist_ok=True)

     return meta
 
 
+def refresh_meta(video_id, rss=None, channel=None, now=None):
+    """Read a video's metadata again and append the snapshot to meta_history.jsonl (meta.json stays write-once)
